pairs.q: What is your return policy?
pairs.a: You can return any unused product within 14 days for a full refund.

pairs.q: Do you ship internationally?
pairs.a: Yes, we ship worldwide. Delivery times may vary by country.

pairs.q: How can I contact support?
pairs.a: You can email us at support@example.com or call +216 55 555 555.

pairs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
pairs.a: We accept credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers.

pairs.q: Do you have physical stores?
pairs.a: We are an online shop only, but we deliver everywhere.

pairs.q: How long does delivery take?
pairs.a: Usually 3–5 business days for domestic orders and up to 10 days for international orders.

pairs.q: How can I track my order?
pairs.a: Once your order ships, you’ll receive an email with a tracking number and a link to track it online.

pairs.q: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
pairs.a: You can request changes or cancellations within 12 hours by contacting support.

pairs.q: Do you offer gift wrapping?
pairs.a: Yes, you can select gift wrapping during checkout for an additional fee.

pairs.q: Are there any shipping fees?
pairs.a: Shipping is free on orders over $100. For orders under this amount, fees are calculated at checkout.

pairs.q: Do you offer discounts or promotions?
pairs.a: Yes, we run regular sales and offer promo codes—subscribe to our newsletter to stay updated.

pairs.q: Is my payment information secure?
pairs.a: Absolutely. All transactions are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways.

pairs.q: What should I do if I receive a damaged or wrong product?
pairs.a: Contact us within 48 hours with photos, and we’ll arrange a replacement or refund.

pairs.q: Do you have a loyalty program?
pairs.a: Yes, you can earn points for every purchase and redeem them for discounts on future orders.

pairs.q: Can I order wholesale or bulk quantities?
pairs.a: Yes, please contact our sales team at sales@example.com for bulk pricing.

pairs.q: Do you offer cash on delivery?
pairs.a: Yes, cash on delivery is available for certain regions—check at checkout for availability.

pairs.q: Do your products come with a warranty?
pairs.a: Yes, most products have a manufacturer warranty. Details are provided on each product page.

pairs.q: Can I create an account to save my information?
pairs.a: Yes, creating an account allows you to track orders, save addresses, and speed up future checkouts.

pairs.q: How do I use a promo code?
pairs.a: Enter your promo code at checkout in the “Discount Code” field before completing payment.

pairs.q: What should I do if I forgot my account password?
pairs.a: Click “Forgot Password” on the login page, and we’ll email you a link to reset it.

pairs.q: Can I pay in installments?
pairs.a: Yes, for certain orders we offer installment payment options through selected providers.

pairs.q: Do you offer same-day delivery?
pairs.a: Same-day delivery is available in select cities—check availability at checkout.

pairs.q: Can I schedule a delivery date?
pairs.a: Yes, you can request a specific delivery date during checkout or by contacting support.

pairs.q: What if I miss my delivery?
pairs.a: The courier will usually attempt delivery again or leave instructions for rescheduling.

pairs.q: Do you sell gift cards?
pairs.a: Yes, we offer digital gift cards that can be emailed directly to the recipient.

pairs.q: Are all your products new?
pairs.a: Yes, all items are brand new and sourced from trusted suppliers.

pairs.q: Can I get an invoice for my order?
pairs.a: Yes, invoices are automatically emailed once your order is confirmed.

pairs.q: Do you have seasonal sales?
pairs.a: Yes, we offer special discounts during holidays and seasonal events.

pairs.q: Can I order from my mobile phone?
pairs.a: Yes, our website is fully mobile-friendly and works on all devices.

pairs.q: Do you offer personalized products?
pairs.a: Yes, certain items can be customized—look for “Personalization Available” on the product page.

pairs.q: How do I unsubscribe from your newsletter?
pairs.a: You can click the “Unsubscribe” link at the bottom of any newsletter email.

pairs.q: What currencies do you accept?
pairs.a: We accept multiple currencies, and the site automatically converts prices based on your location.

pairs.q: Can I save items to buy later?
pairs.a: Yes, you can add products to your wishlist if you have an account.

pairs.q: Do you restock sold-out items?
pairs.a: Many products are restocked regularly—sign up for stock alerts on the product page.

pairs.q: Do you offer eco-friendly packaging?
pairs.a: Yes, we use recyclable packaging materials whenever possible.

pairs.q: Can I place an order without creating an account?
pairs.a: Yes, guest checkout is available, but you won’t be able to track your order history.

pairs.q: Do you ship to P.O. boxes?
pairs.a: Some carriers do, but please check at checkout or contact support for confirmation.

pairs.q: Do you provide assembly services?
pairs.a: For certain products, assembly service is available for an extra fee.
